messages:
amanda: FYI - we just saw a cache invalidation spike in EU causing 503s around 18:34 UTC. Looks correlated with the canary push "v1.8.3-canary". I want to hold the rest of the rollout.

deploy-bot: Deploybot noticed elevated error rate. Auto-action: PAUSE rollout for v1.8.3-canary.
```
release: v1.8.3-canary
artifact: sha256:abc1234def
status: PAUSED (error rate > 1.2%)
canary: 30% -> paused
```

sanjay: confirming the 503s, tailing cache logs now. suspect invalidation TTLs + a bad key format from the new serializer.

ops-oncall: oncall here. Good call to pause. If it's serializer-related we should quarantine the artifact and rollback canary to v1.8.2. Quick question: do we want immediate rollback or keep paused for a hotfix?

amanda: let's quarantine the artifact and rollback canary to v1.8.2. We need time to reproduce and validate. No further promotion until QA signoff.

lia: I'll create a quarantine tag in the release registry and add notes. Adding task for QA to run the failing prompt set.

deploy-bot: Action log: quarantine tag applied to sha256:abc1234def by @amanda at 18:40 UTC. Canary rollback initiated to v1.8.2.

ben: Quick checklist: 1) Pin traffic routing to v1.8.2 2) Run replay of affected traffic slice 3) Run canary smoke tests on staging prior to any re-rollout. I can take #2.

sanjay: running traffic replay now against staging cluster, collecting fails. ETA ~12m. Also dumping serializer payloads to S3: s3://redwood-debug/incident/1804123456/payloads.tar.gz

ops-oncall: Note for release calendar: hold change window for tonight's 22:00 UTC push. We should reschedule to the next low-traffic window tomorrow 02:00 UTC unless hotfix proven.

amanda: Agreed. Reschedule to 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC (change window). Lia, please update the release notes and the calendar invite. Also pin the version in the deployment config so the old canary can't auto-promote.

lia: done. Calendar updated and pinned config PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/deploy-config/pull/432. Release notes draft added in #release-notes.

sanjay: replay results: serializer mismatch causing malformed cache keys for ~0.7% of requests -> spike in cache misses causing downstream 503s. Attached logs in the incident ticket.

amanda: Target plan: quarantine artifact, rollback canary (done), run patch branch with serializer fix in staging, run full smoke + replay, then canary at 10% ramp for 30 minutes, then decide. If any error >0.5% stop and rollback.

ops-oncall: I'll keep monitoring EU region and will escalate if new alerts pop. Add me to the postmortem.

deploy-bot: Note: automatic rollout hold in effect. No scheduled promotions until manual resume.

ben: I'll own the follow-up checklist and the go/no-go call at 01:15 UTC. If tests green, we aim to start canary at 02:00 UTC with explicit manual resume.

amanda: Thanks all. Short-term: no new deploys to production until patch validated. Long-term: add a serialization schema test to pre-deploy pipeline.

lia: adding ticket for serialization schema test to backlog: TICKET-2219.

sanjay: attaching the failing payload sample in the incident ticket for the research team.

ben: :lock: hold acknowledged. I'll ping again 01:00 UTC for the go/no-go.

amanda: closing thread for now, will reopen if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
